subject.title: [Bug]: sessions_spawn child runs fail after acceptance with HTTP 401 Missing scopes api.responses.write

question: For native `sessions_spawn`, should child runs inherit the requester session's effective runtime/auth profile when no explicit child route is configured, and should explicit OpenAI model overrides fail before acceptance when the required auth context is unavailable?
rationale: The fix crosses session-state inheritance, provider/auth routing, explicit model override semantics, and async acceptance behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent contract alone.

options.title: Inherit effective runtime/auth and fail early
options.body: Child runs inherit the requester route/auth context by default, and spawn returns an immediate error when the selected route cannot execute.

options.title: Keep config-driven child routing
options.body: Child runs continue to resolve from subagent/default config, and the issue becomes a docs or diagnostics task rather than an inheritance bug.

options.title: Require explicit child route selection
options.body: Maintainers could require configured subagent model/auth policy before spawn instead of implicit inheritance, trading compatibility for explicit control.

recommendation.title: Inherit effective runtime/auth and fail early
recommendation.body: Child runs inherit the requester route/auth context by default, and spawn returns an immediate error when the selected route cannot execute.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history and release stabilization touched the exact subagent/model-selection files in this shallow checkout.
